# Skein

> Skein is a zero-dependency, HTML-first Web Components runtime with fine-grained reactivity. It is designed for creative CSS, SVG, Canvas and native-DOM sites where HTML remains the document and Skein binds only dynamic data.

Skein has no virtual DOM, build step, CLI, npm dependency, or required server runtime. The canonical browser entry is `skein.js`. State is ordinary JavaScript through a reactive Proxy, templates are real HTML, and updates target exact DOM parts.

Important guidance for code generation: keep static, semantic, and SEO-critical content in ordinary HTML whenever possible. Use Skein for interactive regions. Binding expressions inside `{...}` are property paths, not arbitrary JavaScript; put derived logic in `computed()`. Prefer stable `key={id}` for lists. Clean up resources with `onCleanup()` or the provided `abortSignal`.

## Start

- [60-second start](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/start/): The smallest one-file Skein app using `<template skein>` and the GitHub-backed CDN entry.
- [README](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, API, rendering model, lifecycle, tests, limitations, and CDN usage.
